types.name: BuildingSO

reviewEvidence.name: BuildingSO
reviewEvidence.compositionAndPersistence: BuildingSO owns a polymorphic BuildingAbilityCollection (`BuildingAbilityContracts.cs:38-92,129-180`) and BuildableObject binds runtime abilities, state modules, visuals, and world registration. State capture/restore is module-ID based (`BuildingStateModule.cs:123-262`). Industrial, environmental, production, and facility behaviors are composed as abilities rather than selected by building ID.
reviewEvidence.reason: The data composition and state boundary are open, but production DI drops additional runtime factories and the climate service selects an already-authored weather-observation capability by one building ID.

types.mainAdjudication: The data composition and state boundary are open, but production DI drops additional runtime factories and the climate service selects an already-authored weather-observation capability by one building ID.
